notes.title: Steam Cloud Saves, Controller Support, New Bookmarking System and more...
notes.content:
As promised in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/856880/view/761771476129939477?l=english]our previous announcement[/url], [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] has now been updated with a host of new features! These include:

[list]
[*]Steam Cloud Saves for both PC and Mac players
[*]New Bookmarking and Saving system
[*]Support for up to three adventurer profiles per gamebook
[*]Controller Support
[*]Comprehensive Steam Deck support
[*]Some UI and Layout improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/b1f904295995df0baaf43c2917b24003f7f93014.png[/img]

Hot on the heels of this update will be the release of [i]Starship Traveller[/i] in a few weeks, along with the announcement of the next [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] gamebook joining the library. Keep an Eye out for that!

notes.title: A big-ish update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! We have an update that we'll be pushing up in the next week or so that brings some QoL improvements to Fighting Fantasy Classics, particularly if you're playing your gamebooks on a Steam Deck.

[h3]1) New Save System[/h3]

Support has been added for three adventure profiles per FF gamebook. This means you can have multiple run-throughs with three different characters, each with 100 page saves (bookmarks) that also include the time and date of the save. We'll also be giving you the ability to delete your bookmarks too, a regularly requested feature! You'll also be able to delete an adventure profile, if you feel you've wandered too far down one of Ian or Steve's notorious story dead-ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/da8548b8a3501909cf01344da0fbae97f146e24e.jpg[/img]

[h3]2) Controller Support[/h3]

We're making full use of modern controllers, with a mind to making the game more playable on your handheld device of choice, or using controllers on your computer. For Steam Deck users this means using buttons to select buttons, roll dice and turn pages, rather than using the mousepad, which can sometimes feel a little cumbersome in FFC. Keyboard support is also included that should hopefully help us when requesting our big green Steam Deck tick!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/d12851958febb3b484ddd258f8b71fc1fe37331e.jpg[/img]

[h3]3) Updates to page layouts[/h3]

And finally, we've made some minor tweaks to the the page layouts, which should now make better use of the original gamebook page dividers - a HUGE part of an FF gamebook's aesthetic. An embossed FF logo will also replace blank, empty pages on the right, which reinforces the FF brand in screenshots, and helps add a bit more character to the presentation.

If you're an FF fan and you've been on the fence with regards to making your Steam library portable, now may be a good time! ːwarlockorcː

Coming very soon.

notes.title: UPDATE 10/02/2022: Under the Hood Loading Improvements
notes.content:
Hi there adventurers! 

For some time now we've been receiving bugs relating to book covers not appearing, bookshelves being empty and in a few cases the game not loading at all. While we've been able to fix these in most cases as they appear, they have been symptoms of a larger problem with the way we loaded books and illustration artwork. Therefore we decided to completely overhaul our book loading system, which should not only completely solve these problems, but will ensure we can more easily and cleanly add new books in the future.

As all of these changes are under the hood, you shouldn't notice any changes to your [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] experience. However as with any software development updates, despite thorough testing, new issues may arise. We're pretty sure this shouldn't be the case, but if you experience any bugs please let us know at [i]minion (at) tinmangames (dot) com (dot) au[/i] or post a new discussion thread in the forum.

May your STAMINA never fail!

[i]The Tin Man Games team[/i]

notes.title: And the next two Fighting Fantasy Classics' will be...
notes.content:
[h2]Creature of Havoc and Temple of Terror![/h2]

Our next two [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] hail from the masters themselves, Ian Livingstone and Steve Jackson. We're currently working hard to get these ready for the FFC library and will announce a release date later this year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/f71d27bea2387d821ceeea18227c25f1aad727ce.png[/img]
[b]Written by Steve Jackson[/b]

[i]Are you ready for the most unusual Fighting Fantasy adventure yet?

You begin this adventure not knowing where you are or who you are. All you know is that you are some kind of creature of instinct, understanding little. During the course of the adventure, it may be possible for you to begin to control your bestial nature, to find out more about yourself, and even to learn your destiny. But even if you know all this, success is by no means certain, for the traps and terrors of Trolltooth Pass are many ... Are you ready — to become the Creature of Havoc?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32824257/ac478e9d59cb46708b7fd445fb0035dae45737dd.png[/img]
[b]Written by Ian Livingstone[/b]

[i]The dark, twisted power of the young Malbordus is reaching its zenith!

All he needs now is to retrieve the five dragon artefacts which have been hidden for centuries in the lost city of Vatos, somewhere in the Desert of Skulls. Each day that passes brings him closer to them and only YOU can stop him! YOUR mission is to reach the lost city before Malbordus and destroy the treasures he seeks. But beware! Each step you take leads you closer to your doom ...[/i]

[h3]Two dice, [strike]a pencil and an eraser[/strike] are all you need to make your journey. YOU decide which route to follow, which dangers to risk and which foes to fight![/h3]

notes.title: v41 Patch Notes

notes.title: New Fighting Fantasy Classics 25% OFF!
notes.content:
TRIAL OF CHAMPIONS has arrived! The sequel to [i]Deathtrap Dungeon[/i] joins a stellar roster of fantasy adventures in [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] - the ultimate library of text-based role playing games. And to celebrate, it's 25% OFF! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]Check it out here.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/a6d64fdadb1fcc1c90a0c798cac92a41bbce8ed9.png[/img]

[i]Trial of Champions[/i] sees you delve into the dread corridors of Baron Sukumvit’s terrible challenge for a second stab at glory. But beware! The Trial will be even more devilishly difficult this time as you begin your adventure having been captured and sold into slavery! With nothing to prepare you for this arduous adventure but your SKILL, LUCK and STAMINA, you must explore the deadly labyrinth beneath Fang. For only by triumphing in the Trial can you win back your freedom from Baron Sukumvit’s evil brother – Lord Carnuss.

Will it be enough?!

Find out for yourself and pick up this classic title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]while it's just 2.99 USD.[/url]

Also joining the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] shelf is another old favourite – Steve Jackson’s [i]House of Hell[/i]. We’ve remastered this title for the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library, so it can take its rightful place amongst your collection. It is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897180/House_of_Hell_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/]also 25% OFF[/url] for a limited time. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/2e02525bf6cbcfc88d0dbeb0a2e7103be93af2fc.png[/img]

[i]House of Hell’s[/i] addition to the library comes with a handful of updates including:
[list]
[*] Adventure Sheet now includes 'Fear' mechanic. 
[*] Knowledge Sheet to track the clues you discover.
[*] Tim Sell’s original artwork, as well as coloured editions of each piece.
[*] [i]Haunted Hallways[/i] ambient track added.
[*] Achievements added for both [i]Trial of Champions[/i] and [i]House of Hell[/i].
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/aaf8f602b920bdc08fb7f9df81eeeee1bd82499c.png[/img]

Whether you're heading into the depths of the labyrinth beneath the city of Fang, or braving the haunted halls of the House of Drumer, may LUCK be with you and your STAMINA never fail!

notes.title: v40 Fixes
notes.content:
Hi adventurers! With the upcoming release of House of Hell and Trial of Champions onto Fighting Fantasy Classics comes some bug fixes.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]
- Fixed an issue with the 'knowledge' sheet sliding off page
- Fixed a save file issue that would crash the game on initialisation
- Fixed multiple grammatical errors in Island of the Lizard King, Bloodbones and City of Thieves

notes.title: v33 Fixes
notes.content:
Hi intrepid explorers, thanks again for playing FF Classics and helping us develop game features and sort out bugs! With your feedback we've been working on more usability options.

[h1] Features	[/h1]
- Fixed UI controls for turning pages left/right. Hover over the centerfold of the game pages to see these buttons.
- Added audio sliders for music and sound effects.

[h1] Fixes	[/h1]

- Fixed a save data problem causing black screens on startup
- Fixed multiple activated items causing game crashes
- Fixed some image problems with Forest of Doom and Island of the Lizard King. We're keen to hear feedback about this fixes, as we have to individually track down these image problems for multiple platforms. Let us know if you are having more problems viewing images!
- Fixed some message problems on skill/luck rolls.

notes.title: Steam Release Hotfixes (v33)
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Fighting Fantasy Classics and supporting our release! We hope you're enjoying the gamebooks.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]
- Added 'Stalking Danger' ambient tracks.
- Added keyboard support (Left/Right Arrows, A/D) for turning pages.
- Replaced the report a bug button on PC/OSX with a notification.
- Fixed a problem with automatically setting FPS limitations.

- Fixed a problem in The Warlock of Firetop Mountain where trying to open the chest after beating Zagor crashes the book.
- Fixed achievement unlocking in multiple books. This will only affect future playthroughs of books.
- Changed resolution naming.
- Fixed the knowledge sheet disappearing offscreen when dragged.
- The Free Choice Heal button will now totally fill your Stamina
- Fixed the Free Choice Rewind button's popup from not exiting on pressing cancel.
- Luck button will no longer appear on the first round of a battle.
